newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers 300 MW peak firm power Fri, prices up.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers 300 MW peak firm power Fri, prices up.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) continued to offer 300 megawatts of peak firm power for next-day delivery, but raised prices by $2.00 to $4.00 a megawatt hour (MWh), the agency said Thursday.

BPA offered peak power during the hours ending 0700-2200 PDT on Friday at $28.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest sales, up $4.00 from Thursday, and at $29.00 for California-Oregon border sales, up $2.00 from Thursday.
BPA also offered 400 MW of peak firm power for Saturday at $25.00 (Northwest) and $26.00 (COB), while non-firm was offered at $25.50 and $26.50.
The agency continued to offer off-peak firm power at $9.00 on Friday and Saturday for all deliveries.
BPA prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0600 and 2300 PDT on Friday were also unchanged at $10.00 per MWh, while prices for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PDT were flat at $9.00 per MWh.
